draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.92, the 175th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 21st of 36 at CB. He went 180th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (87th percentile). College production: 4 passes defended in 2022, 31st of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 43 career games and 9 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 17.5% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
